title: Graduate Engineer Apprentice (GEA) and Technician (Diploma) Apprentice (TA)
qualification: Candidates applying for Technician (Diploma) Apprentice positions must have completed a three-year Engineering Diploma in one of the prescribed branches on or after 1 April 2024. The qualification must be obtained from an Indian institution recognised by the appropriate statutory authority.
salary: Important: These amounts are apprenticeship stipends, not regular employee salaries. ECIL has clearly stated that completing apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment or create a right to claim a job in the organisation.
age_limit: ECIL provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates according to the official recruitment notification. || Candidates claiming age relaxation must provide the applicable category or disability certificate during document verification.
selection_process: The ECIL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is based on qualifying examination marks and original document verification. Candidates will be called for document verification at CLDC-ECIL Hyderabad based on their online application details. After successful verification, selections will be made according to merit in the qualifying Engineering Degree or Diploma examination.

title: Fitter, Electronics Mech., Machinist (C), Machinist (G), Welder and other trades
qualification: 10th/SSC pass + ITI pass in the respective trade
age_limit: A General candidate must be not less than 14 years and not more than 30 years of age. Age is counted as on 30.09.2026.
selection_process: Selection is based on merit under the Apprentices Act 1961, followed by a medical examination before induction. || A list of candidates who applied is drawn separately for each trade. || A separate merit list is prepared for each trade from the marks scored in the essential qualification, with equal weightage to 10th/SSC marks and ITI marks. || Average marks are calculated as (10th or SSC marks / maximum marks x 0.5 + ITI marks / maximum marks x 0.5) x 100. || Selected candidates must pass the prescribed medical examination as per rules in force before induction into the training course.

title: Junior Assistant, Librarian Gr.III, Lab Attender, Office Subordinate, Watchman and other posts
qualification: Degree with proficiency in Office Automation with usage of computer and associated software / Must hold a Bachelor's Degree of any university in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any equivalent qualification.
salary: The notification does not print the pay amount for each post or any allowances.
age_limit: For all posts, the applicant should have completed 18 years of age and should not have completed 54 years of age as on 01.07.2026. The notification does not list any separate age relaxation.
selection_process: The two groups of posts are selected in different ways. For Junior Assistant, the written examination and oral interview are waived.
